narrative.northStar: App-like on mobile, complete on desktop.
narrative.overview:
This guide documents the implemented Al Mina storefront as of 20 November 2026. The owner selected the full-width campaign, five wide home columns, and the image-first N03 phone product detail. The current review revision uses Plus Jakarta Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic with a warm mineral palette. The final local screens and release boundaries are recorded in the [Phase 6 review packet](docs/design/implementation-evidence/phase-6.md).

Shopping controls stay compact and legible. Product photography, exact identity, stock, money and purchase actions carry the hierarchy. Apothecary green identifies primary actions. Coral is reserved for cart counts, sale tags and urgent alerts. The actual logo remains unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Search-led navigation with delivery context and useful discovery.
Quiet near-white ground, dark type and dark labels on coral.
Quiet product cards with contained factual photography and readable prices.
Image-first phone PDP with contextual overlay controls and persistent buying.
Equivalent English/Arabic tasks and desktop/mobile continuity.

rules.name: The action-foreground rule.
rules.body: Normal labels use text on action, including hover/pressed and pending. Measured contrast is 4.94:1 at rest and 4.73:1 on hover/pressed. White on action is only 3.05:1 and is unsuitable for normal text. Focus uses a separated visible outline, not a low-contrast coral halo.

rules.name: The state-meaning rule.
rules.body: Selected options use their quiet neutral surface plus current/pressed semantics. Bottom navigation retains its observed active-navigation text with aria-current; it does not use the option surface. Added/success uses positive treatment and a real count/status; saved uses its heart/pressed state; error uses explicit invalid/alert treatment. Offer text/surface is separate from error and cannot imply an actual promotion without verified data. Stock/unavailable retain literal status text. Inactive controls use disabled roles; their 3.92:1 text pairing is an inactive-control exemption, not a normal-text pass.

rules.name: The feedback-motion rule.
rules.body: Background, border and text changes and pointer press feedback use 120ms. Pointer-initiated menu, review and campaign disclosures use the 180ms entry role. Confirmed status indicators can fade in on the same timing. Both use `cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1)`. Keyboard carousel controls render the next slide immediately. Reduced motion preserves immediate final states. Pack comparison and navigation stay steady. Stroked UI icons use Heroicons at 22px/1.5, with separate filled dirham artwork.

dos: Do preserve the accepted direction, actual business content, English/Arabic tasks and server authority.
Do use the single scoped runtime token/state owners and verify emitted/computed CSS, portal ancestry and live resizing.
Do test names, missing content, unavailable/pending/failed states, focus, enlarged text and purchase clearance.
Do preserve shared/admin consumers until replacement is verified and distinguish local direction acceptance from release acceptance.
donts: Don't restore retired lavender/teal candidate values, split desktop lead or standalone phone PDP toolbar as default guidance.
Don't generate a competing palette/font/token system from skills, metadata snippets, references or the archive.
Don't copy unsupported ratings, delivery promises, medical claims, prices, discounts, services or payment availability.
Don't deploy, access production data or change commerce behavior as part of this design phase.
